# FinancialLibrary

> Open educational knowledge base on household financial literacy: regulated
> savings and investment *types* by country, plain-language guides, and curated
> links to official regulator/government resources. Educational only — never
> personalized financial advice.

## Start here

- [Knowledge base guide for agents](https://github.com/ananddw24/safe_investment_researcher/blob/main/docs/knowledge-base.md): how to query this base, freshness semantics, and citation rules
- [Machine-readable index (JSON)](https://github.com/ananddw24/safe_investment_researcher/blob/main/data/kb-index.json): one consolidated index of every resource and vehicle record, regenerated weekly
- [Documentation site](https://ananddw24.github.io/safe_investment_researcher/): human-readable guides, vehicle pages, and pathways
- [Resource catalog (generated tables)](https://github.com/ananddw24/safe_investment_researcher/blob/main/docs/resources/catalog.md): all curated official links by country
- [Using this library (human readers)](https://github.com/ananddw24/safe_investment_researcher/blob/main/docs/about/using-this-library.md)

## Data (source of truth)

- Resource records (YAML): `data/resources/` in the repository — one file per curated official resource, each with `id`, `url`, `country`, `topics`, `source_type`, and `last_checked`
- Vehicle records (YAML): `data/vehicles/` — machine-readable records for regulated savings/investment types, each with `id`, `country`, `category`, `official_url`, `docs_path`, and `last_reviewed`
- Schemas: `data/schemas/resource.schema.json`, `data/schemas/vehicle.schema.json`

## Rules for agents using this base

- Educational use only. Do not turn records into personalized recommendations.
- Respect freshness: every record carries a verification date (`last_checked`
  for resources, `last_reviewed` for vehicles). Treat records older than 180
  days as stale and say so when citing them.
- Cite the record `id` and its official URL, not this repository, as the
  authority. Prefer `source_type` values from regulators and governments.
- Rates, limits, and scheme rules change; verify against the official source
  before presenting any figure as current.

## Maintenance

- Weekly automated maintenance validates all records, rebuilds
  `data/kb-index.json`, and files a maintenance issue when records go stale.
  See `.github/workflows/weekly-maintenance.yml` and
  `scripts/staleness_report.py`.
